Name: Jozabad, Overseer
Summary: Jozabad was one of the overseers under Cononiah and Shimei over the offerings and tithes under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Jozabad was one of the overseers under Cononiah and Shimei over the offerings and tithes under Hezekiah.
RelatedPeople: Cononiah, the Levite; Shimei, Brother of Cononiah; King Hezekiah; Azariah, Chief Priest
LifeLesson: Many overseers together kept one storehouse honest.
